anomaly_signals.detail: p99 latency of 10,335ms strongly suggests LLM response times are severely degraded. llm-gemini accounts for 10 spans across all traces, making it a likely primary contributor to tail latency.
1 error span observed in agent-service (1 of 4 spans = 25% local error rate). Likely a downstream consequence of llm_degradation causing timeouts or failed LLM calls within agentic workflows.

recommended_action: Investigate llm-gemini latency — check Gemini API quotas, rate limits, and upstream provider status. Consider increasing LLM client timeouts or enabling a fallback model to prevent agent-service cascading failures. Monitor agent-service error rate for further escalation.
summary: The active llm_degradation scenario is manifesting as a severe p99 latency spike of ~10.3 seconds, primarily attributed to llm-gemini. A single error in agent-service (25% of its spans) indicates the LLM slowdown is beginning to cascade into agentic workflows, though overall system error rate remains low at 1.3%.
